title: Lush Dirt F Off !
description: A datapack for crafting Lush dirt into dirt.
body: Oh The Biomes We've Gone have transform all dirt into Lush Dirt, this makes me so confuse. Some of the mods have crafting recipes using dirt or used in bulit in minecolonies, without dirt is unplayable. So I created a datapack just to craft Lush Dirt in to dirt, hope I can solve the issue for anyone have the same issue as me.
